author: Retro Game Corps
description:
There's now a super easy way to play retro games on an Android TV box, thanks to a new launcher called Cannoli. In this video I'll show you how to set this up on a $30 ONN Walmart TV box.

Cannoli website: https://cannoli.dev/
Cannoli documentation: https://cannoli.dev/documentation/
Supported platforms: https://cannoli.dev/documentation/platforms/
Cannoli discord: https://discord.gg/QKTjTQ796q

ONN Streaming box: https://www.walmart.com/ip/ONN-4K-PLUS/15557424949
Older ONN guide video: https://youtu.be/HptlIXLSZUQ

Recommended controllers:
8BitDo SN30 Pro: https://amzn.to/46nWuaC
GameSir Nova Lite: https://amzn.to/49PElF4
GameSir Nova Lite 2: https://amzn.to/45ACMZ1
